title: Relative functor categories for a Cartesian fibration
statement:
Use quasicategories, spaces, coherent functor categories and equivalences from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], Cartesian and cocartesian fibrations from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and coherent cocartesian classification from [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening]. Fix containing universes for all the following data. Let $p:Z\to B$ be a Cartesian fibration of small quasicategories, with coherent fiber transport $f^*:Z_{b'}\to Z_b$ for $f:b\to b'$. Let $C$ be a quasicategory in the containing universe. There is a cocartesian fibration $v:V_C\to B$ classified by the coherent functor $b\mapsto\operatorname{Fun}(Z_b,C)$ and $f\mapsto(-)\circ f^*$. For every small simplicial set $T$ with map $t:T\to B$, the relative functor construction gives an equivalence of quasicategories
$$\operatorname{Fun}_{B}(T,V_C)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(T\times_B Z,C).$$
The left side is the quasicategory of functors over $B$ and coherent transformations over the identity on $t$. The equivalence sends $s$ to a functor whose restriction at a vertex $a\in T$ is the value $s(a):Z_{t(a)}\to C$. The equivalence is natural in $T$, in base change, and in $C$, including all higher simplices. For a cocartesian fibration $t:T\to B$, a functor $s:T\to V_C$ over $B$ preserves cocartesian edges if and only if its corresponding functor $T\times_B Z\to C$ sends every edge $(\eta,\epsilon)$, with $\eta$ a $t$-cocartesian edge and $\epsilon$ a $p$-Cartesian edge over the same base edge, to an equivalence. For an edge of $V_C$, the same test is applied after base change to its base edge $\Delta^1\to B$, taking the identity cocartesian fibration $T=\Delta^1\to\Delta^1$. The pullback above represents the infinity-categorical pullback since $p$ is a Cartesian fibration.
